scope: training-only channel scoring; no tuning or final evaluation
formula: For each channel and calibration scene, delta = ablated mean-image masked MAE minus baseline mean-image masked MAE; average score is mean(delta); scene-aware score is mean(delta)+0.5*max(delta). Rank ascending; break ties by channel index. No clipping of negative deltas.
limitations: Single-channel effects ignore group interactions; selection is a small scene sample; candidate novelty and pretraining independence unverified.
